I’ve just added the Intro and Input components, and the logo generation now works. The next piece missing is the main TUI entry point that ties everything together: rendering the UI, handling input, managing state, displaying messages, tools, approvals, suggestions, and the intro flow. The repository already has a `src/tui.tsx` file stub (or maybe it doesn’t exist yet). I need to create or overwrite it with a full implementation.

First, I consider what imports are required. The rest of the codebase uses Ink for React rendering, so I’ll need to import React and Ink primitives (`Box`, `Text`, `render`, `useApp`, `useInput`, `useStdin`). I also need to bring in the command handling utilities (`COMMANDS`, `resolveCommand`, `runCommand`) from `./commands.ts`. The agent core (`AgentState`, `newAgentState`, `runTurn`) lives in `./core/agent.ts`. For auto‑compact, I need `AUTO_COMPACT_THRESHOLD` and `compactHistory` from `./core/compact.ts`. Config handling (`EFFORT_LEVELS`, `MODEL`, `VERSION`, `Effort`, `loadConfig`, `saveConfig`) is in `./core/config.ts`. Diagnostics (`SESSION_ID`, `trace`) from `./core/diagnostics.ts`. Logging (`logger`) from `./core/logger.ts`. Pricing (`formatCost`) from `./core/pricing.ts`. Protocol helper (`visiblePrefix`) from `./core/protocol.ts`. Session persistence (`loadSession`, `saveSession`) from `./core/session.ts`. Skills (`expandSkill`, `listSkills`, `loadSkill`) from `./core/skills.ts`. Types for tool approvals (`ApprovalRequest`, `TodoItem`) from `./core/tools.ts`. UI components (`Approval`, `Input`, `Intro`, `Markdown`) from `./components/...`. Theme constants (`SPINNER_FRAMES`, `THINKING_VERBS`, `theme`) from `./theme.ts`.

Next, I need to define the UI state shape. The existing code uses an `Item` type with `kind` covering banner, user, assistant, tool, notice, error, shell. I’ll replicate that, plus a global `nextId` counter for unique keys. There are also interfaces for pending approval, suggestions, and a helper `toolHint` to summarize tool arguments. I’ll also add a small utility `fmtTok` for formatting token counts.

I must provide the effort menu options, matching the effort levels defined elsewhere, plus an extra “ultracode” option. That will be used when the user invokes the effort command.

A `TpsMeter` class is needed to track tokens‑per‑second over a sliding window and compute an up/down trend; this mirrors the existing implementation in other parts of the repo.

Now for the main `App` component. It receives CLI options (`yolo`, `intro`, optional `resume`). I’ll load the config, apply the yolo flag, and set up state hooks: phase (`intro` vs `ready`), items list, running flag, stream buffer, thought lines, expansion toggle, thinking flag, active tool info, pending approval, todos, spinner index, elapsed time, TPS and trend, usage/cost metrics, context token count, history of inputs, current input value, suggestions array, suggestion index, effort menu visibility and index, and a ctrl‑C arming flag.

References (`useRef`) will hold mutable objects: the agent state (`stateRef`), abort controller (`abortRef`), current thinking verb (`verbRef`), title (`titleRef`), TPS meter (`meterRef`), reasoning buffer (`reasoningBufRef`), and active tool hint (`activeToolHintRef`). A `push` helper adds items with unique IDs.

I need several `useEffect` hooks:
1. On phase becoming ready, push a banner, start a diagnostics trace, and if a resume ID is provided, load that session, populate state, title, and push a notice (or error if not found).
2. When `running` becomes true, start an interval to update spinner, elapsed time, TPS, and trend, clearing it on cleanup.
3. Enable mouse tracking for thought expansion when running and thoughts are enabled.

The input handling via `useInput` must support:
- navigating the effort menu,
- toggling thought expansion with ctrl‑t,
- aborting with esc,
- handling ctrl‑c double‑press to quit (arming logic).

The core `run` function wraps `runTurn`, handling streaming output, thought updates, tool start/end, approvals, usage/cost updates, notices, todos, and error handling. It also performs auto‑compact after each turn if needed.

Suggestion computation (`computeSuggestions`) filters commands and skills based on a leading “/”.

`onInputChange` updates the input value, recomputes suggestions, and clamps the suggestion index.

`submit` processes the entered text:
- updates history,
- clears suggestions,
- handles shell passthrough (`!` prefix),
- handles commands (`/` prefix) including skill loading, ambiguous command handling, and dispatching to `runCommand` which can return various result kinds (text, effort‑menu, clear, quit, intro, compact, resume, submit).
- For normal text, pushes a user item and calls `run`.

The render logic must handle the intro phase (show `<Intro>`), then the main UI:
- static list of items with appropriate rendering per kind (banner, user, assistant via `<Markdown>`, tool with hint and preview, notice, error, shell output).
- streaming assistant response.
- optional thought dropdown with expand/collapse.
- spinner and status line showing active tool or thinking verb, TPS trend, elapsed time.
- approval modal.
- effort menu modal.
- todos list.
- input box with suggestion dropdown, handling suggestion navigation and acceptance.
- footer line with model, effort, token usage, cost, yolo/diagnostics flags, help hint.

Finally, a `Banner` component prints the glint header with version, session ID, cwd, and help hint. The `startApp` function renders the `App` and ensures mouse mode is reset on exit.
